notes: The comment field stays its usual size while listening, with the waveform, words and keyboard button centred.
Boards stay drawn while you zoom in and out.
Notes, diagrams and docs your agent draws to explain its work now match your canvas in dark mode.
Artboards keep their id, size and content while a script is still writing their file.
Drag a page's tab along the bar to reorder your pages.
Moving a page to the front no longer switches the page you're looking at.
Comments are written in one floating field, without a sheet: typed or spoken words go in the same place, and Send sits inside it.
The comment field grows again as you type past one line.
The comment field grows smoothly as you type.
On iPhone Duo held open upright, the page menu works when a Live Activity shortens the bar.
